steps.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, outpainting, production sprite atlas. Edit the existing Big Fat Fish / 大肥鱼 expression atlas into ONE new animated sprite atlas for a 240x320 companion device. Reference 1 is the previous 3x2 character atlas, the exact character to retain (same sapphire eyes, navy hair with blue tips, short sweeping forelock, white frilly maid headband, white-underlined whale-fin ears, blue bows, navy maid uniform with gold details, navy tail on viewer right). Reference 2 is ganfan.jpg, definitive rice action and prop: navy bowl heaped with white rice held at chest in one hand, brown chopsticks in the other, cute rounded gesture. Reference 3 is deyi.jpg, definitive speaking posture and expression: both eyes confidently CLOSED, a small raised fist by the near cheek, other hand on waist, blushing smug happy OPEN pink mouth. Reference 4 is wuyu.jpg, definitive error: flat droopy half-lidded blue eyes, tiny straight mouth, one small blue anime sweat drop on cheek, arms resting at sides, three small dark vertical exasperation strokes above the character's left fin. All poses are front or very slightly turned as in the originals.

CRITICAL DELIVERABLE: ONE 1536x1024 PNG, exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows of EQUAL 384x512 PORTRAIT cells. Eight sprites total. No gutter, no separators, no grid lines, no drawn labels or text. Tile origins at x=0,384,768,1152 and y=0,512. A genuine hard-clean TRANSPARENT background, including gaps between arms/tail/hair. No shadows, floor, backdrops, emblems, fake transparency, glowing or border effects. Render every character independently within its cell. This is a tight repeatable animation registration with EXACT same face/head/forelock/headband/z-order and exact same waist, skirt and tail position across every cell. Maintain polished chibi sticker anime cel shading with dark clean outlines and cobalt hair glints.

NEW FRAMING, VERY IMPORTANT: Extend the visible character well below the waist in every single frame. Draw a FULL flared navy skirt across the bottom, white ruffled apron with the small whale embroidered near the bottom, white scalloped petticoat hem, restrained gold ribbon and stitching on navy. Draw the entire long right whale tail curling down behind the dress to the same lower level as the dress and then sweeping up to viewer right, matching wuyu. Skirt and tail must fill the lower 30% of each cell. In every cell the forelock starts high at y=15..30, eye line near y=215, waist near y=360, skirt spreads to its lower full width at y=458..480, and the skirt hem and tail bottom reach y=505..510 (only a few pixels clear on the bottom). Full body through the hem, no shoes, no legs, no empty bottom band. Full tail fin and both fin ears stay safely within x=14..370, very large head as on the previous atlas, keep face centered around x=188. Do NOT add a baked-in fade, a white haze, or transparency across the skirt; the device will apply a fade behind its footer to the solid lower skirt. The old atlas's short cut-off waist/fa ding must be removed and extended to the full bottom hem on all eight sprites.

Exact tile order, reading left to right:
TOP 1: RICE REST. Eyes open with tiny closed smile, hold the navy bowl of white rice in front of chest and chopsticks poised just above the rice at her left, matching ganfan.
TOP 2: LISTEN. Open attentive eyes, closed little mouth, raise two rounded pawlike fists just under each cheek like reference 1's top middle. No bowl.
TOP 3: THINK. Open sapphire eyes looking slightly left, index finger touching chin like reference 1 top right. No bowl.
TOP 4: SPEAK OPEN. Match deyi sticker: BOTH eyes closed in two confident happy sweeps, cheek blush, pronounced OPEN happy pink mouth, left hand fist near cheek and right hand on hip. A tiny golden wedge accent to viewer-left optional; no bowl.
BOTTOM 1: RICE CHEW. Same bowl and body registration as top 1. Chopsticks now level near the corner of the mouth, eyes briefly closed contentedly, puffed little cheeks and CLOSED chewing mouth. No floating rice over the face.
BOTTOM 2: ERROR. Match wuyu sticker: both half-lidded blue eyes, horizontal deadpan expression, tiny closed neutral mouth, one blue sweat drop, arms lowered, three short cluster strokes above left fin. No bowl and no question mark.
BOTTOM 3: RICE BITE. Same bowl position as top 1 and same body and eyes. Lift the chopstick tips visibly toward her open pink mouth; a SINGLE discrete tiny clump of white rice pinched between tips near mouth, no giant hand or rice covering face.
BOTTOM 4: SPEAK CLOSED. Exact visual copy of top 4 down to eyes, hand and hair positions, bow, golden accent and tail. ONLY CHANGE: mouth CLOSED into small pleased smile. No rice bowl. This is the closed mouth counterpart for an animation loop.

Deliver all eight solid shape cutouts with transparent negative space, exact layout, same scale. Preserve full skirts and tails at the bottom and readability of white rice, eyebrows and hands at tiny scale.
